entities.name: Miralem Halilović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miralem Halilović is a Bosnian professional basketball player for Bosna of the Bosnian League and the ABA League. He is also the captain of the Bosnia and Herzegovina national basketball team. He plays at the power forward and center positions.
